release: Halo CE VR - Immersion Evolved v0.1.0-alpha.1 (R1.37)
changes: Add Sitting/Standing posture and height in cm under Comfort; default Sitting ignores height.
Use corrected standing calibration: 180 cm gives 0.60 m below-head belt depth; 0.43 m sitting depth.
Move hip/supply grab zones and belt previews/labels together; preserve shoulder grab and chest zones.
Rebaseline grip edges when belt positions change without resetting weapon ownership.
Retain R1.36 Magnum empty-slide lock and all other R1.35 behavior.
Prepare Immersion Evolved identity, Windows update packaging, credits and author permission evidence.
Replace inherited Arial font files with Liberation Sans 2.1.5 and include dependency notices.
